stanza: I lept from the cliff into a pool of Jersey river water
I smashed my arm and my leg on the rock going down
But when I rose from the depths, and nearly death
What a friendly world I found!

partner.line: But when I rose from the depths, and nearly death

q.line: When they went through his personal effects
stanza: When they went through his personal effects
In among the stubs from the welfare checks
Was a crumbling picture of a girl in a door
An address in Dallas and nothing more

partner.line: In among the stubs from the welfare checks

stanza: Drop it, drop it on them
Drop it, drop it on them!

partner.line: Drop it, drop it on them
